'''Nexhat Daci'''{{efn|{{IPA|sq|neˈdʒat ˈdaːtsi|lang}}}} (26 July 1944 – 1 January 2026) was a Kosovan [[politician]] who served as the speaker of the [[Assembly of Kosovo]] from 2001 to 2006. A member of President [[Ibrahim Rugova]]'s [[Democratic League of Kosovo]] (LDK), he also served as acting president following Rugova's death in January 2006.<ref>{{cite news|title=Kosovo launches historic parliament|url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/europe/1701352.stm|publisher=BBC News|date=10 December 2001|access-date=21 January 2011}}</ref> In March 2006, he was ousted from the speakership due to infighting within the LDK.<ref>{{cite news|title= Kosovo prime minister steps down |url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/europe/4763400.stm|publisher=BBC News|date=1 March 2006|access-date=21 January 2011}}</ref> He also led the [[Democratic League of Dardania]], which he founded following his unsuccessful bid to become leader of the Democratic League of Kosovo.

==Education==
{{Prose|date=January 2026|section}}
* 1962–1966: [[University of Belgrade]], Chemistry Section, Diploma in chemistry;
* 1966–1968: University of Belgrade, Master studies, Master of Science;
* 1969–1973: [[University of Zagreb]], studies for doctorate, PhD in chemistry;
* 1971: School of English Language, [[Folkestone]], United Kingdom;
* 1972: After Master Studies, [[Liège]], Belgium;
* 1973: Hydro project, [[Brno]], [[Czechoslovakia]];
* 1974–1975: [[University of Bradford]], United Kingdom, ''after PhD Studies''.

Daci spoke English, [[Serbo-Croatian language|Serbo-Croatian]], German (passive) as well as his native [[Albanian language|Albanian]].

He was an academic and was a member of the [[The Academy of Science and Arts of Kosovo|Academy of Science and Arts of Kosovo]].

==Activities and functions held==
* 1985: [[American Chemical Society]]- Regular Member;
* 1987: [[European Academy for Environment]], Tybigen, Germany – Regular Member;
* 1994: [[Academy of Sciences and Arts of Kosovo]] (ASAK) – Regular Member;
* Participation in Congresses, Conferences, Symposia in the US, the UK, Germany, Italy, Turkey, Hungary, Slovenia, Croatia, Serbia, Albania, Kosovo

===Publications===
* School Textbooks for primary and secondary school, and University – 10 in total;
* Scientific projects – 120 in total.

===Other activities===
* 1970–1972: Manager of the Chemistry Section in the [[University of Pristina (1969–1999)|University of Pristina]];
* 1970: Professor in the University of Pristina, Faculty of Chemistry;
* 1992–2001: Member of Parliament of the Republic of Kosovo;
* 1992–2026: Member of the General Council of the [[Democratic League of Kosovo]], since its inception;
* 1994–1998: General Secretary of the [[Academy of Sciences and Arts of Kosovo]] (ASAK);
* 1998–2002: President of the [[Academy of Sciences and Arts of Kosovo]] (ASAK);
* 2001–2006: Speaker of the [[Assembly of Kosovo]]

== Death ==
Daci died in [[Pristina]]{{fact|date=January 2026}} on 1 January 2026, at the age of 81.<ref>{{cite news |date=1 January 2026 |title=Former Speaker of Parliament Nexhat Daci passes away |url=https://telegrafi.com/en/Former-Speaker-of-Parliament-Nexhat-Daci-passes-away/ |access-date=1 January 2026 |publisher=Telegrafi}}</ref>
